name: Tantei Opera Milky Holmes
original_name: 探偵オペラ ミルキィホームズ
source: The story takes place in an imaginary world in "the Age of Detectives", where private detectives and phantom thieves overwhelm the cities. Both detectives and phantom thieves have special powers known as Toys. Former great detective Kobayashi Opera, who lost his Toys five years ago in a battle with Phantom Thief L, is tasked with leading a team of four junior detectives as they battle against the newly formed Phantom Thief Empire.
translation: 故事发生在一个名为“侦探时代”的虚构世界，私家侦探与怪盗横行于各座城市。侦探和怪盗都拥有被称作“Toys”的特殊能力。昔日的名侦探小林奥佩拉五年前在与怪盗L的战斗中失去了Toys，如今受命带领一支由四名见习侦探组成的队伍，与新成立的怪盗帝国展开对抗。
